chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd al-Sabāṭī, I have narrated it from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd al-Sabāṭī.

key_terms.السَّابَاطِيِّ: A nisbah identifying ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd as al-Sabāṭī.
key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ: A nisbah identifying Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā as al-ʿAṭṭār.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a transmission formula indicating narration.
key_terms.فَضَّالٍ: The family name Ibn Faḍḍāl, a known transmitter lineage in hadith chains.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd al-Sabāṭī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage provides the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd al-Sabāṭī. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission, which is essential in hadith sciences for identifying sources and preserving scholarly attribution.
